implementation.evaluation: Prepared numeric programs can suspend at a missing parameter and resume with evaluator stacks, function frames, complex values and prior random draws intact. The existing immediate and directional evaluators use the same execution loop without suspension.
implementation.graph: An explicit stack and cycle set resolve retained ordinary/global dependencies lazily. Distinct namespace caches preserve ordinary shadowing, and authoritative global expressions are reevaluated while captured static statistical projections remain values. Function formals precede external bindings of the same spelling.
implementation.materialization: Temperature option scopes resolve retained dependencies on demand and publish ordinary static values once; global bodies retain authoritative expressions with resolved projections. Repeated option reads and later finalization do not redraw shared statistical bindings.
implementation.validation: Static definitions use the numeric expression evaluator and an isolated statistical stream, admitting complex accessors such as IMG. Runtime definitions retain existing runtime-language validation. General ordinary finalization evaluates numeric ASTs rather than real-valued text substitution.
implementation.cancellation: Parser finalization preserves typed cancellation, and graph traversal polls between dependency resumptions. Inner compilation, expression evaluation and structural validation are not newly claimed as bounded cancellation points.
